# pokemon-cards-css
Source: https://github.com/simeydotme/pokemon-cards-css/tree/acb1197633e749a1fba4412231db2f6581586d00
Commit: acb1197633e749a1fba4412231db2f6581586d00
License: MIT, see LICENSE.
Original recipe files are preserved here. Runtime CSS changes only selector scope (.card → .bp-cards-css) and local image paths. Shared shine/glare and sunpillar definitions extracted from base.css. Basketball adapter defines full-face clipping and a lower-opacity central region to protect the subject and titles. No Pokémon card artwork is included.
